title: Roadmap: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (qwen4_exp) serving on Gaudi 2 via vllm-gaudi

execution_model.note: Do the cheap P4 pin check before investing heavy kernel authoring in P3.

phases.title: Platform feasibility & memory planning (Gaudi-2 gate)
phases.goal: Confirm FP8 is a real runtime path on Gaudi 2 and size HBM/TP correctly.

tasks.desc: Load Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 checkpoint on Gaudi 2 eager; FP8 E4M3/E5M2 is supported, so no re-quantization fork.
Benchmark FP8 MME throughput/maturity on Gaudi 2 vs Gaudi 3 (Gaudi 3 headline 1.8 PFlops FP8; Gaudi 2 lists FP8 without matching PFlops).
Re-derive TP degree, --max-model-len, --gpu-memory-utilization for Gaudi 2's 96GB/2.45TB/s (vs PR's Gaudi 3 128GB/3.7TB/s, 0.80 util).
Set required flags: --kv-cache-dtype auto, VLLM_SKIP_WARMUP=true, --enforce-eager, --language-model-only.

Benchmark HCCL inter-collective bandwidth (allreduce/allgather/all2all) on the Gaudi 2 fabric via HCCL Testing/Benchmarking, BEFORE fixing a TP/EP topology. Rationale: EP (expert-parallel) for MoE is an all-to-all dispatch/combine pattern; feasibility depends on measured all2all throughput, not primitive existence. Gaudi 2: 2.4 TB/s HBM, on-chip 24x100 Gbps RoCE.

exit_criteria: FP8 checkpoint loads and produces deterministic single-token probes on Gaudi 2 eager.
A TP + max-model-len + memory-util config fits without OOM.
Measured allreduce/allgather/all2all bandwidth recorded; TP/EP target chosen from measured numbers.

phases.title: Reuse PR #1829, retarget to Gaudi 2 / plugin 0.30.0
phases.goal: Correct eager forward via reuse, not re-derivation.

tasks.desc: Base on vllm_gaudi/models/qwen4_exp.py (~2.4k lines): GDN (reuse HPUGatedDeltaNetAttention, 48V/16QK/128), QSA (HpuQSAIndexer+HpuQwen4ExpQSAAttention), PLE (HpuQwen4ExpPLENorm+HpuQwen4ExpNGramEmbedding), HyperConnection (HpuGatedResidual).
Register Qwen4ExpForCausalLM + Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration via ModelRegistry.register_model; add arch to maybe_set_mamba_kv_cache_groups_ids in hpu_model_runner.py.
Retarget from PR pin dd3bc9c72faf to plugin 0.30.0 stable pin (satisfies c05d75a+).
Carry fp8 MoE block-grid fix (_effective_moe_block_size) from extension/ops.py.
Honor modules_to_not_convert; drop mtp.* head at load.

exit_criteria: PR smoke battery (arithmetic, geography, code, needle retrieval) reproduces on Gaudi 2.

phases.title: Cache & memory plumbing (HBM fit + prefix caching)
phases.goal: Stable under concurrency; correct prefix-cache semantics.

tasks.desc: Migrate QSA raw-key ring + compressed-key side cache + PLE dilated-conv state + n-gram trailing-token history from module-allocated per-state-slot buffers to scheduler-owned KV blocks (PR's tracked follow-up; more urgent on smaller Gaudi 2 HBM).
Keep prefix caching OFF until P2.1 lands (hybrid default on HPU).
Confirm decode block buckets clamped to physical KV cache size (plugin v0.30.0 feature) is active.

exit_criteria: Stable at concurrency 8+ without side-cache OOM; prefix cache correctness restored after P2.1.

phases.title: Custom kernels for three hard primitives (CustomOp/TPC)
phases.goal: Replace eager fallbacks with fused TPC kernels; in your control, not Intel-gated.

primitives.name: FP8 n-gram gather-then-dequant
primitives.dtype_note: stays FP8 on Gaudi 2 MME; no INT8 re-expression

steps: Write kernel body in TPC-C via TPC SDK (same path Intel uses for its own kernels).
registerUserCustomOp(schema, tpc_guid, OutputMetaFn, optional FillParamsFn); types in hpu_custom_op_pt2.h.
Build execution fn via getUserCustomOpDescriptor + execute.
Define op with TORCH_LIBRARY; HPU dispatch via TORCH_LIBRARY_IMPL; add Meta impl for torch.compile.
Compile op.cpp against habana_pytorch2_plugin; load with torch.ops.load_library.
hard_limits: Single TPC kernel per UserCustomOpDescriptor; multi-op Python decomposition recreates eager dispatch cost.
Must register in custom_op namespace for full torch.compile support (gates P4 capture).

exit_criteria: Each primitive is a single CustomOp, byte-equal to eager reference on Gaudi 2; per-step dispatch count drops vs eager.

phases.title: Cheap graph-capture win (do before heavy P3)
phases.goal: Determine if the upstream pin alone unblocks compiled mode for GDN/HyperConnection.

tasks.desc: Verify build pin is at/after c05d75a (Keep Qwen3Next layer boundaries sequence parallel) — resolved synStatus-26 #1734 for GDN hybrids with NO plugin change.
Test boot without --enforce-eager on Gaudi 2; capture which subgraphs still fail.

exit_criteria: Documented list of remaining capture-failing subgraphs after the pin fix.

phases.title: Compiled (HPU-graph) mode: off eager-only
phases.goal: Serve with --enforce-eager removed, or hybrid compiled+eager.

tasks.desc: Integrate PR #1843 mitigations: DS=0 concrete-plan recipe, host-side decode count fix, bmm score contraction fix, flat index_copy_ store rewrite (restores first-request survival).
Eliminate host-coercing ops in QSA/PLE hot paths: .nonzero (PLE _pool_and_store), .item(), torch.minimum (_expand_plan), keep.any() (KV-store epilogue).
Ensure each P3 CustomOp satisfies single-kernel + custom_op namespace requirements for capture.

exit_criteria: Boots/serves on all TP workers without --enforce-eager, or documented per-subgraph eager fallback for QSA indexer only.

phases.title: Throughput for Gaudi 2 MoE economics
phases.goal: Usable serving speed given issue #1733 on Gaudi 2 low batch.

tasks.desc: Apply opt-in gathered-expert MoE combine for FP8 (plugin v0.30.0, in spirit of Qwen3.5/3.6 MoE work).
Pre-register throughput protocol (mirroring PR seeds 301-303) before/after each lever for attribution.

Tune decode bucketing. Treat higher TP / expert-parallel as a MEASURED decision gated on P0.5 all2all bandwidth (EP MoE = all2all dispatch/combine over interconnect), not a default lever; expect higher TP/EP than PR's TP4 Gaudi 3 only if measured all2all supports it.

exit_criteria: Documented cost-per-token curve on Gaudi 2 across concurrency 1->target with identified saturation point.

phases.title: Feature parity (deferrable, product-driven)
phases.goal: Optional capabilities beyond text-only language serving.

tasks.desc: MTP speculative decoding: implement HPU MTP drafter in hpu_model_runner.py (only ngram/eagle/medusa exist) or accept dropped mtp.* head.
Vision tower: implement ForConditionalGeneration vision stack if multimodal required (PR excluded it).
Enable prefix caching + regression coverage after P2.1.

exit_criteria: Per-feature: not required for text-only serving enablement.

risks.desc: Gaudi 2 FP8 MME throughput lower than Gaudi 3 (unverified; measure in P0.2).
risks.mitigation: P0.2 micro-benchmark; treat as perf not feasibility.

risks.desc: Gaudi 2 HBM (96GB/2.45TB/s) pressures eager sparse-MoE workspace + QSA side caches.
risks.mitigation: P2.1 block-managed side caches; lower max-model-len/memory-util.

risks.desc: Sparse top-k not graph-capturable even as single CustomOp (compiler-layer control-flow limit).
risks.mitigation: Hybrid compiled+eager for QSA region only.

risks.desc: #1733 low-batch MoE slowness on Gaudi 2 dominates end-to-end throughput.
risks.mitigation: P5.1 gathered-expert combine; higher concurrency; market for high-concurrency only.

risks.desc: No public Intel roadmap for remaining primitives -> P3 is on you (SDK/CustomOp).
risks.mitigation: Use TPC SDK + PyTorch CustomOp API contract.

risks.desc: Expert-parallel MoE feasibility hinges on HCCL all2all bandwidth on Gaudi 2 interconnect (primitive exists; throughput unverified). Docs flag collectives/congestion as config-sensitive.
risks.mitigation: P0.5 benchmark all2all/allgather; fall back to pure TP (allreduce/allgather only) if all2all is weak.
risks.source: HCCL index (NCCL emulation layer, collectives incl. all2all); primitives table page 404 under 'latest' - per-primitive caveats unverified
